notes: Existing accepted GLB and native textures unchanged. Motion overlays use real rest-bone axes and a single continuously advanced base clip.

Wave placement follows Whitlow et al. (2019): Osteoglossum bicirrhosum is a subcarangiform BCF swimmer that undulates about the posterior two-thirds of its body with wavelength increasing posteriorly.
Absolute amplitudes and routine-turn curvature remain conservative visual inferences because the cited arowana study classifies gait but does not report joint angles.
Conservative head-centered envelope is verified from skin influence lever arms plus rest bone-chain path lengths during configure.
